projects.title: The truth amid chaos
projects.description:
In a world full of noise, assumptions, and chaos, we created Hopinion, a space that helps us stay focused, human, and always up to date.

Our motto is clear: “Assumption is the mother of all mistakes! When assumptions stop, certainty begins.” With this belief, and with the aim of rebuilding trust in market research by making it more transparent, ethical, and deeply human, we created this unique platform.

For a long time, the market research industry has operated behind the scenes, sharing very little about how data is collected, how investments are made, and which methodologies are used. This…
